reason: The premise is wrong. EXP75 PARTNER RULE v2 (CONTEXT 14:12Z) (a) makes exp75 >= 0.955 (clean) favour pair B {V_pub, exp75} whatever probe 51 reads. Only exp75 = 0.954 together with 51 '-' demotes B to a trade, and even then B stays on the card. A file that was never submitted cannot be ticked, so dropping exp75 removes pair B, the only CI-on-#37 private hedge (mc26 bronze .828 vs .747 for A; model-conditional). That is a decision about the private board (~71% of the test), traded for a public read. Under 51 '-' the CI evidence is split: probe 48 gave +0.001 on exp70g, and 51 would be '-' on K. That makes exp75's read the tie-breaker, so it gains value rather than losing it. exp89s at 01:26Z goes in blind: Q (exp89q vs exp89p) is unknown when it is submitted. Branch B already reads DIS 2.25 through Q. When DIS reads '0' or '-', exp89s is a redundant second public read of a dropped lever, and it bypasses the user's 12:25Z condition 'morning = stack of night winners' (R26F-4 already refuted exp89s as V_pub). When DIS reads '+', morning M1 submits exp89s anyway; the read lands ~18:00-18:40Z, before the 20:00Z tick, and the PENDING clause covers it. So the only gain is an earlier read, and only in the DIS '+' world. The freed M1 slot has no ready non-CI filler: exp89l is CI and branch A only, and exp89t/u are off by the user's default. The swap is technically feasible (exp89s dummy PASS 1,566 s; 01:26Z is >= 40 min after 00:46Z; the 5/day count is unchanged). But it changes a user-confirmed slot, needs a yes the user has not been giving (15:43Z defaults), and adds a session-dependent submit at 04:26 MSK after today's network outage.
fix: No change. Keep the 12:25Z night (00:05Z exp89q/r, 00:06Z exp75, 00:46Z exp89p) and MORNING TABLE v1.1 branch B (M1 exp89s only on DIS '+'). Do not ask the user this question.
